Commentary.Commentary: We are set for the chase te begin! The players of Sri Lanka stride out to the middle. Paul Stirling and Kevin O'Brien are the opening batters for Ireland. Chamika Karunaratne to start with the ball.
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Now though, they need to concentrate on their batting. The target is a big one, not going to be easy to chase this down and they will need the big guns to come to the fore. Sri Lanka will back themselves to get over the line. Join us for the chase shortly.

Josh Little is down for a chat. He says that he is feeling pretty good and the score is about par. Adds that there is not much swing here but they adapted quite well by changing things up. Credits Wanindu Hasaranga for the way he batted.

The Irish bowling was good at the start courtesy of Josh Little and good at the end but the middle period could cost them the game. The likes of Mark Adair, Simi Singh and Curtis Campher just were not upto the mark and they just let the game slip away. Ireland will be very disappointed they let Sri Lanka off the hook.

It was Wanindu Hasaranga who emerged as the hero for Sri Lanka! He was promoted up the order and he played a knock to remember. He along with Pathum Nissanka got things back on track with a brilliant counter-attacking partnership. Within no time, Sri Lanka were back on top. They added over 120 with both scoring fifties. However, once they fell, Ireland did manage to pull things back a little but Sri Lanka will be pretty pleased.
What a first innings did we just witness! Full of action! Have to say Sri Lanka will be the happier of the two, especially after they were 8 for 3.
FOUR! That is played so well! A full one, on leg. Dasun Shanaka gets into position and scoops it over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary. Sri Lanka end at 171 for 7!
SIX! That is huge! Mark Adair bowls a short and one slower one. Dasun Shanaka is waiting for it and then pulls it way, way over the mid-wicket fence.
A full toss, on the pads. Whipped to deep square leg for one.
Dushmantha Chameera is the new man in.
OUT! BOWLED! A screeching yorker, on off. Chamika Karunaratne looks to heave it but misses. The ball hits the stumps. That is the 50th wicket for Mark Adair in T20Is!
On a length, outside off. Heaved wide of long on and the batters scamper back for the second.
Full ball, on off. Hit down to long off for one.
Mark Adair will bowl the last over of the innings.
Excellent delivery to end the spell! Yorker, on off. Hit back to Josh Little, who finishes with brilliant figures of 4-0-23-4.
Chamika Karunaratne walks out now.
OUT! TAKEN! A really good knock by Pathum Nissanka ends as he chases a wide one! Full and way outside off. He chases it and gets the outside edge. Neil Rock takes the catch behind the stumps.
Commentary.Howout: c Neil Rock b Josh Little

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, outside off. Dasun Shanaka hits it down to long off for one.
Full ball, outside off. Pathum Nissanka misses the flick. The keeper fails to collect and they get a bye.
Full ball, outside off. Heaved to mid on for one.

FOUR! That is hit so hard! On a length, on leg. Shanaka walks down the track and pulls it to the mid-wicket fence. The TV umpire is called in and the replays show that the ball bounces just before the ropes. Boundary.
Short ball, on off. Dasun Shanaka walks down the track to pull but gets the top edge. The ball goes behind the bowler, who chases it and keeps it to one.
Slower ball, on a length, outside off. Heaved to deep mid-wicket for one.
Just a single as this is drilled to mid off.
Short of the fielder! Full ball, on off. Pathum Nissanka hits it in the air to long on. The fielder runs in to take the catch but in the end, takes it on the bounce. One taken.
Back of a length, on the pads. Clipped to fine leg for a single.
On a length, on off. Dasun Shanaka misses the flick.
Craig Young (3-0-19-0) comes back to bowl.
A yorker, on off. Pushed to covers for a quick single.
Leg bye! Full ball, outside off. Pathum Nissanka moves across and looks to scoop but he misses and gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls behind the sticks and they take a leg bye!
Dasun Shanaka walks out to bat.
OUT! TAKEN! It is hit well, but not well enough! Full ball, on the pads. Bhanuka Rajapaksa flicks it in the air. The man at deep mid-wicket, Harry Tector, settles under it and takes it.
Commentary.Howout: c Harry Tector b Josh Little

Commentary.Commentary: Yorker, outside off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa gets no bat on it.
A low full toss, outside off. Hit down the ground. The man from mid on gets to his left and stops the ball.
FOUR! Edgy boundary! Full ball, on off. Pathum Nissanka goes for the drive but gets the outside edge. The ball runs to the third man fence.
A full toss, way outside off. Left alone and called a wide.
Josh Little (2-0-10-2) comes back to bowl.
Full ball, on the pads. Pathum Nissanka looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls away and they take a leg bye.

Length ball, on off. Pathum Nissanka gets the inside edge on the pads. The ball rolls away and they set off for one. Nissanka runs into the bowler and the single is taken with ease. It was called a dead ball, but the umpires have changed their mind. It will be a dot ball in the end.
FOUR! What placement! On a length, outside off. Pathum Nissanka takes a step down the track, opens the face of the bat and runs the ball between short third man and backward point for a boundary.
Full ball, on off. Pushed past covers for one.
Bhanuka Rajapaksa walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! A brilliant knock from Wanindu Hasaranga comes to an end! He has got his side out of trouble and his teammates would surely acknowledge this effort! Full-length ball, around off. Hasaranga looks to go over cover but it goes off the thick outside edge. The ball goes straight to Josh Little at short third man who gulps it down! Mark Adair is pumped up and Ireland would look to pull things back now.
Commentary.Howout: c Craig Young b Mark Adair

Commentary.Commentary: Length ball, on leg. Pathum Nissanka tucks it to the leg side for a single. He brings up his fifty now!
Change. Mark Adair (2-0-15-0) is back on.
On a length, outside off. Wanindu Hasaranga drives it to the left of the sweeper cover and collects a couple of runs.
Length ball, outside off. Pathum Nissanka drives it to deep cover for one.
FOUR! EDGY! Short ball, outside off. Pathum Nissanka goes for the pull but it goes off the top edge and into the fine leg fence.

Short ball, outside off. Wanindu Hasaranga looks to cut but he gets the underedge and the ball goes to Josh Little at short third man. There is a mix-up between the batters and Hasaranga scampers through towards the non-striker's end. Little throws it to the bowler but Curtis Campher fails to collect it cleanly and Hasaranga survives.
FOUR! Top shot! A slower ball, on a length, around off. Wanindu Hasaranga gets down on his knee and goes inside out over extra cover for a boundary.
Short of a length, outside off. Wanindu Hasaranga backs away and punches it past covers to collect two runs.
Floated, around middle. Hasaranga lofts it towards long on for a single.
FOUR! Punished by Hasaranga! A full toss, around off. Wanindu Hasaranga carves it past point for yet another boundary.
FOUR! Nicely done! Fuller in length, around off. Wanindu Hasaranga gets low and opens the face of his bat. The ball goes past the diving short third man fielder and into the fence.
Tossed up, outside off. Wanindu Hasaranga carves it past covers and takes a couple of runs.
Quicker ball, on middle. Pathum Nissanka tucks it to the leg side for a run.
Flatter ball, on middle. Pathum Nissanka flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Change. Simi Singh (2-0-27-0) is back on.
Short of a length, outside off. Wanindu Hasaranga cuts it to deep cover for a couple. A lovely shot to get to his fifty and this has been a sensational knock from him so far.
Review time. Ireland have reviewed this for LBW. There is no bat on that one. It is umpire's call on hitting!

NOT OUT! Leg bye! Length ball, jagging back in from middle and leg. Pathum Nissanka misses his flick and gets rapped on the pads. The ball rolls away towards backward point and Nissanka looks to sneak in a leg bye but Hasaranga sends him back. The fielder at point has a shy at the striker's end but he misses. The batters cross for a leg bye! Ireland opt for a review but the Ball Tracker shows that the ball would have just clipped the bails and it is umpire's call! Nissanka survives!
Slower ball, on a length, outside off. Wanindu Hasaranga drives it to deep point for one.
Full ball, on off. Pathum Nissanka drills it to mid off and collects a run.
Length ball, angling in around off. Wanindu Hasaranga blocks it to cover and takes a single.
DROPPED! Good-length ball, outside off. Pathum Nissanka hits it hard to Andy Balbirnie at covers who drops a tough one! A single taken.
Craig Young (2-0-13-0) is back on. But there is a slight halt in play as Wanindu Hasaranga is getting attended to by the physio.
Back of a length, outside off. Wanindu Hasaranga pulls it to wide of deep mid-wicket to collect a couple.
FOUR! Quality stroke! Back of a length, outside off. Wanindu Hasaranga carves it over point. The man in the deep runs to his left and slides but cannot stop the ball.
Fuller and on off, Pathum pushes it to covers and they take one. Quick running.
Direct hit but the batter is well in! Fuller and on middle, this is worked through mid-wicket. Two taken.
SIX! That is one of the best shots so far! Lovely! Fuller and outside off, this is lofted over covers by Pathum Nissanka. It goes all the way. Welcome biggie as the pressure just started to build.
Fuller and on off, this is played to covers.
Swing and a miss! Adair bangs it into the deck, outside off. Wanindu Hasaranga skips down to pull but he misses out. Just 2 runs off the over!
Length ball, around off. Pathum Nissanka pushes it to mid off and scampers through for a quick run.
Full ball, outside off. Wanindu Hasaranga makes room on the off side to drive it through covers. He gets the outer half of the bat and the ball goes to the sweeper cover fielder. A single taken!
Three dots in a row! Good-length ball, outside off. Hasaranga drives on the up but finds the extra cover fielder.
Slower ball, shorter in length, outside off. Hasaranga cuts it to backward point.
Full toss, around off. Wanindu Hasaranga pushes it to cover.

Drinks break! Sri Lanka have managed to get back into the game after having lost 3 wickets for just 8 runs, thanks to some sensible batting from Wanindu Hasaranga and Pathum Nissanka! They would be hoping that these two bat deep and take them to a good total now! Mark Adair is back on.
Good running! Shorter ball, outside off. Pathum Nissanka pushes it wide of long on and gets a couple.
Full ball, on off. Pushed down to long on for one.
Darted on off. Clipped to deep mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Pathum Nissanka gets in the attack now! Short ball, way outside off. He reverse-sweeps it to the third man fence.
Wanindu Hasaranga gets his bat changed and also has his cap on now!
Just a single as this is played to long on.
Tossed up, on off. Pathum Nissanka comes down the track and plays it to long on for one.
A single to end! Outside off, this is played through point for one.
Fuller and outside off, this is driven through covers. Wanindu Hasaranga takes one and turns for the second but is sent back in time.
Another dot! Yet another one on off, Hasaranga opens the face and plays it to point again.
Good length and on off, Wanindu guides it to point.
Just short! Fuller and on off, Hasaranga looks to drive, this goes more off the outside edge but lands just short of Little who dives forward to collect it at the point region.

A collision but no harm done! On the pads, Nissanka looks to flick but misses. It hits the pad and rolls on the leg side. They go for a run. The bowler goes for the ball and he collides with Wanindu Hasaranga. Leg bye signaled.
SIX! Over the fence! It is a long boundary but Hasaranga does not care! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled over the long on fence for a biggie. Spoils the over.
Lands safe! A slower one, on middle, Hasaranga is early in the loft, it lands away from the man at mid-wicket. Two taken.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On off, this is lofted down the ground, not off the middle for one.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
On off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Craig Young comes back to bowl. Just 2 runs came off his first over.
Full ball, on the pads. Pathum Nissanka clips it past mid-wicket for one.
Another single as this is pushed to deep cover.
Length ball, on off. Tapped to mid-wicket for one.
Short of a length, outside off. Wanindu Hasaranga guides it to deep cover for one.
A single as this is tapped down to third man. 50 up for Sri Lanka.
Length ball, on off. Pathum Nissanka punches it past covers for a couple of runs.
Curtis Campher comes to bowl.

FOUR! Make that 4 in a row and the momentum has completely shifted now. On off, this is tossed up, it is lofted over covers by Wanindu Hasaranga. Boundary. End of the Powerplay. Sri Lanka are 47 for 3 after it.
FOUR! Smashed! This time Wanindu Hasaranga steps out, this is shorter and on off, it is slapped through covers. Another boundary.
FOUR! Up and over! A little too full and Wanindu Hasaranga puts it away! He makes room again, Singh tosses it up this time. Hasaranga lofts it over covers. Bags another boundary.
FOUR! Cut away! Runs starting to flow now! Hasaranga makes room again, this is fired on middle, it is cut through point.
Hasaranga makes room and this is bowled fuller and on middle, Hasaranga hits it to mid off.
On middle, this is eased down to long on for one.
Simi Singh comes into the attack.
A low full toss, on middle, it is pushed back to the bowler. A dot to end but the damage was done earlier on.
FOUR! Third boundary in the over! All the pressure that was building has been eased off now. A full one on middle, this is driven down to the long on fence.
Good length and on off, PN plays it late and down to third man for one.
Good length and on off, blocked.
FOUR! Just used the pace there! Lovely stroke and this is not what Ireland wanted. Outside off, Nissanka guides it past point. Races away. Two boundaries in a row.
FOUR! Welcome runs for Pathum Nissanka now! Edgy four but Sri Lanka won't care! Full and outside off, Nissanka goes after it, it flies off the outside edge and down to the third man fence.
Mark Adair comes into the attack.
A dot to end! On off, this is guided to point.
FOUR! Lovely shot and a very much-needed boundary! Back of a length and on off, Wanindu Hasaranga stands tall and pushes it through covers. Boundary. Can this break the shackles?
That hurried onto the batter! Shorter and on the body, Pathum Nissanka is late on the pull, he gets hit on the body. It rolls on the leg side. A leg bye.
Just the one again! Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Fuller this time and on off, this is pushed to covers. Another dot.
Outside off, Hasaranga swings but misses.
A single to end another tidy over! Outside off, Wanindu Hasaranga slashes at it, it goes off the outside edge down to third man for one.
That one hits low on the bat! On off, stays low. Hasaranga looks to drive but it goes off the bottom back to the bowler.
A single now! On middle, Nissanka works it towards mid-wicket for one.
On middle, defended again.
On middle, Pathum pushes it to mid on.
Outstanding fielding! The fielders are close in, stopping the singles. Shorter and on off, this is played towards point where the fielder dives and stops it.
A dot to end then! A really good over by Little. Two wickets in it. On off, blocked.
WIDE! Very well done by the keeper! This is way down the leg side, swings away further. Hasaranga lets it be. The keeper dives to his left and gets a hand to it. Saves four runs.
That is a very good delivery but Wanindu Hasaranga does well to block it. No hat-trick! Length and on off, Hasaranga gets right behind the line and defends.
Wanindu Hasaranga is the new man in.

OUT! TIMBER! Two in two for Josh Little! This is a huge wicket as Avishka Fernando was the man in form for Sri Lanka. What a start this is for Ireland and Little is over the moon! Another length ball, this one comes back in a little after landing outside off. Fernando looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the off pole. On a hat-trick is Little.
Avishka Fernando walks out to bat at number 4.

OUT! TIMBER! Two in two overs for Ireland and they are on a roll here. Little gets his revenge and Sri Lanka once again lose two in quick time and are in trouble. Wrong shot selection! Short and outside off, not very wide. Chandimal looks to cut, not enough room, he gets an inside edge back onto the stumps.
FOUR! Put away! Chandimal gets the first boundary of the game! Comes down the track and this is bowled wide outside off, Chandimal reaches out for it, he hits it through point for a boundary.
This one stays low! Shorter and outside off, Chandimal slashes but misses.
Who will bowl from the other end? Josh Little it is.
Quicker ball, around middle and leg. Dinesh Chandimal tucks it to the leg side to collect a run.
A half-tracker, outside off. Dinesh Chandimal drags it back to the bowler.
Flatter ball, on middle and leg. Pathum Nissanka works it to long on to rotate the strike.
Dinesh Chandimal walks out to bat.
Tossed up, around off. Dinesh Chandimal eases it to long on for a single.

OUT! TAKEN! That is a really good catch by Gareth Delany! Tossed up, on off. Perera chips it in the air towards covers. Gareth Delany dives forward and claims the catch. The soft signal is OUT and the TV umpire is called in. The TV umpire takes a look at it from multiple angles and then decides to stay with the on-field soft signal.
Commentary.Howout: c Gareth Delany b Paul Stirling

Commentary.Commentary: A decision for a clean catch has been sent upstairs. The soft signal from the on-field umpire is OUT! Gareth Delany at covers has put in a dive to catch the ball.
Pathum Nissanka and Lanka are underway! Fuller and on middle, this is eased down to long on for one.

The players of both teams walk out for their respective national anthems! First, it will be the national anthem of Ireland, followed by the anthem of Sri Lanka! We are done with the national anthems of both teams and the players of Ireland are in a huddle before striding out to the middle! Kusal Perera and Pathum Nissanka are the opening batters for Sri Lanka. Paul Stirling to start with the ball.

PITCH REPORT - Ian Bishop says the off side is a lot shorter, the leg side is a lot bigger and down the ground is with the wind, adds the wicket looks a belter. Simon Doull says the right-hander's leg side is the shorter part and he expects a lot of short balls. Ends by saying 180 might be needed.

Dasun Shanaka, the skipper of Sri Lanka, says that it is a very good wicket. Adds that they will look to bat better in the Powerplay. Says that they are high on confidence due to their last win. Finishes by saying that they have the same side.

Andy Balbirnie, the skipper of Ireland, says that they will bowl first. Mentions that it is a night game and they would look to make use of the dew factor. Adds that they need to be smart irrespective of whether they are batting first or bowling. Finishes by saying that they have one change.

Ireland (Playing XI) - Paul Stirling, Kevin O'Brien, Andy Balbirnie (C), Gareth Delany, Curtis Campher, Harry Tector, Neil Rock (WK), Simi Singh, Mark Adair, Josh Little, Craig Young (In for Benjamin White).

Sri Lanka (Unchanged Playing XI) - Kusal Perera (WK), Pathum Nissanka, Dinesh Chandimal, Avishka Fernando, Bhanuka Rajapaksa, Dasun Shanaka (C), Chamika Karunaratne, Wanindu Hasaranga, Dushmantha Chameera, Maheesh Theekshana, Lahiru Kumara.
Toss - Up goes the coin and it lands in favor of Ireland. They will bowl first.

Both these teams won their last match thanks to their bowling but they are more than capable to put on a big score on the board. It will be interesting to see what the captain who wins the toss opts to do first. But expect a high-intensity bowling performance by both these sides yet again here.

Game 2 of the day is a very crucial clash, a game between two sides that one their first game and need just a win to make it through. Ireland will be taking on Sri Lanka. The Lankans are favorites to win this one but they’ll have their task cut out against an Ireland side that has a lot of quality. Stay tuned for the toss in a bit.
